1.1 Introduce an extra variable $s$ and consider the autonomous system below on $\mathbb R\times\mathbb R^n$. [L1]

$$s'(t)=1,\qquad x'(t)=F(s(t),x(t)).$$

Its right-hand side is smooth. By [L1], this augmented autonomous system has a unique local smooth flow.
operations.new: 1.1 On the open state domain $D\subseteq\mathbb R\times\mathbb R^n$, define the augmented autonomous field $V(s,x)=(1,F(s,x))$, so its equations are $s'(r)=1$ and $x'(r)=F(s(r),x(r))$. This field is smooth on $D$. Apply [L1] with open state domain $U=D$ at $(t_0,x_0)$: there are $h>0$ and an open neighbourhood $W\subseteq D$ of $(t_0,x_0)$ such that every initial pair in $W$ has a unique augmented solution on the common elapsed-time interval $[-h,h]$, taking values in $D$. [given, L1, construct]
